_about.description: Provenance of every tracked file under linear_a/data. One entry per file. kind is one of derived, source transcription, export, documentation, code, placeholder. For derived, source transcription and export files, generator is either a script in this repository with the command that runs it, or the string hand-maintained when no script in this repository builds the file; inputs names what the file was built from; post_passes lists, in order, the dated scripts that changed it afterwards. scripts/release_gates.py gate 8 fails when a tracked file under linear_a/data has no entry, or when a data entry lacks generator or inputs.

the private companion repository docs/browser-data.json, read only, for the 2026-09-18 write-back

post_passes.command: the rule in verification/pseudo-word-fix-2026-09-18.md: drop words[0] where it equals the join of words[1:]
